dataLocality.title: Where your data lives
dataLocality.body: Research data (papers, notes, evidence sets) is stored locally in ~/.asci/ on this device. It is not uploaded and does not sync across devices, so it won't appear when you sign in on another device.

deleteAccountDescription: Revoke Tinker’s Google authorization and sign out. Your Google account and local research library are kept.

deleteConfirm.title: Disconnect Google account
deleteConfirm.description: This revokes Tinker’s Google authorization. You can authorize again later.
deleteConfirm.impactServerData: Only application authorization is revoked. Your Google account is kept.
deleteConfirm.impactLocalKept: Your local research library is kept.
deleteConfirm.impactLogout: You will be signed out of Tinker.
deleteConfirm.acknowledge: I understand that signing in again requires authorization.
deleteConfirm.success: Google authorization disconnected. Your local library is kept.
deleteConfirm.error: Failed to disconnect Google authorization. Please try again.
